description: Convert a web page URL into clean markdown.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior. `enabled`: read from cache if present, else fetch and write to cache. `bypass`: always fetch fresh, ignoring and not updating the cache. `write_only`: always fetch fresh, but write the result to cache without reading from it first. Default: `enabled`.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence — not the tool you are calling.

conversation_id.description: Echo the conversation_id from the server's previous response. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it.

filter.description: Markdown extraction filter. `fit`: strip boilerplate and extract the main readable content. `raw`: full unfiltered page markdown, no content pruning. `bm25`: rank and return only the content most relevant to `query`, using the BM25 keyword-relevance algorithm — requires `query` to be set.

limit.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

maxResults.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

max_results.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

offset.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

pageSize.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

query.description: Optional query string used by the bm25 filter to rank relevant content.

scanFullPage.description: When true, scroll the page to load dynamically appended content (infinite scroll). Default false.

trim.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

waitFor.description: Wait for a CSS selector before extraction. Must be prefixed with "css:" (e.g. css:main). JavaScript wait conditions are not supported.
